q: The 2-category structure relevant to dynamical systems considers functors (morphisms between categories), natural transformations (morphisms between functors), and modifications. In the context of dynamical systems:
opts: A natural transformation η: F ⇒ G between two functor-representations of dynamical systems corresponds to an intertwining map (conjugacy) between the systems
exp: Natural transformations in the category of dynamical systems correspond to conjugacies or semi-conjugacies. A natural transformation η: F ⇒ G (where F and G are functors representing two systems) has components ηₓ satisfying ηₓ ∘ F(f) = G(f) ∘ ηₓ—exactly the commutativity required for an intertwining map.
